column7: Vose & Sons antique upright piano (name on fallboard), painted green over original finish, gilt panels. Vose & Sons is a respected Boston maker (restored ones list $2-4k at antiquepianoshop.com); unrestored/painted ones realistically $200-500 local. Low confidence, moving cost $150-300 eats it. Check: serial/era, keys play, cracked soundboard/pinblock, ivory, bring piano dolly + 3-4 people; walk if it will not tune.
Beckett-graded One Piece promo card (BGS 9.5-type slab), no sold comp found that clears $120; unidentified promo, single card likely $30-80.
Common 90s Jordan Fleer/Upper Deck/Skybox/Topps base and insert cards in sleeves; commons sell $1-5 each, lot worth ~$60-100, ask already $100.
Marx HO train set 1960s box; Marx HO sets sell roughly $50-100 (dfarq Marx guide: cars $5-10, engines $10-35); priced near value.
Chilling Reign Peonia secret rare, back of card shown; singles ~$10-25, cannot clear $100.
Pokemon lot, only a card back in sleeve shown, nothing identifiable; no evidence of value.
55 MTG Duskmourn-era cards, mostly commons/uncommons with a few rares; bulk value well under $50.
Bo Nix lot: Leaf Prized Rookie #2 graded 10 lists ~$11 on eBay (72 BIN listings $0.99-$39.99), plus SGC 9 and a Rookie Revolution slab; total ~$60-80 vs $75 ask.

Zenith Trans-Oceanic (black leatherette, gold dial, pushbuttons = H500 style) with cracked/damaged lid mirror. Working H500s sell ~$250-400, untested ~$150-250 (eBay/napoleonexhibit comps). Ask $75 so negotiate ~$60. Check: powers on, tubes glow, AM/SW reception, battery tray corrosion, antenna/lid wiring, back panel and chicken-head knobs present, model tag (H500 vs 7G605/other).

Marshall CODE combo (Code 25/50) plus Fender Mustang I/II V2 modeling amp, both visible. Used Marshall Code 50 range $156-231 on Sweetwater Gear Exchange; Mustang I V2 used ~$80-120 at Guitar Center. Ask $50 may be for one amp or lot. Check: both included for $50, power on, speaker not blown/crackling, footswitch/power cable, which Code size (25 vs 50).
Coca-Cola bottle vending machine is a 1980s-90s Cavalier-type, not a Vendo/Dixie classic; $200 is around value, heavy, needs truck.
Japanese 30th Celebration box (Premium Deck Set Espeon/Umbreon); retail resale ~$190-200 and sold out at stores (poke-collect.com), $180 is priced at value.
Red upholstered Eastlake-style settee, worn fabric, wood frame partly rough; needs reupholstery, bulky, local resale ~$100-250 at best vs $105 ask.
L.C. Smith Super Speed typewriter, dirty, 1940s-50s common model; sells ~$50-100, ask $50.
1950s Raytheon TV/radio/turntable console, large cabinet, tube TV and record player likely nonworking; consoles sell $100-250 local and are slow movers, ask $200.
M Rayquaza EX full art single (XY Roaring Skies/Japanese); worth ~$20-40, cannot reach $100.
Boxed S.H.Figuarts (Turles, Majin Buu, one more) bought at $100; resale net of fees ~$150-180 total, under 3x.
Colston Loveland Panini-style rookie card (RC logo, not auto), $30 is around market, value ~$20-40.
Modern oak pedestal roll-top desk, common reproduction; sells $100-250 and sits for weeks, bulky, truck; $50 ask leaves thin margin after effort.

Halo 3 Legendary Edition (Xbox 360) in outer box with orange "Do not sell before 9/25/2007" sticker, helmet replica. Complete used sets sell ~$200-300; sealed more ($350+). Ask $125, offer ~$75-100. Check: shrinkwrap sealed or open, game disc/metal case/Making-of DVD included, helmet intact, box corner wear.

Free grey dental/aesthetic exam chair with powered base and foot control (A-dec/Pelton style). Used dental chairs list $300-1000 locally, buyers are niche. Heavy (~250-400 lb), hard to move. Check: brand/model plate, powers up and tilts, upholstery tears, pump/hoses, headrest/arms, bring two people + dolly; skip if only one pickup trip is available.

Funko Pops lot: Kurogiri Deluxe (#1245, Specialty Series exclusive, ~$25-40), Tengen Uzui vs Gyutaro Moment #1753 (~$25-40), plus other boxed Pops (Rui, Kaido, MHA) in frame. Priced as $1 placeholder so real price unknown. Check: actual asking price, how many Pops in the lot, box condition, Specialty Series sticker, protectors.

Two PSA slabs, Japanese: Umbreon ex Special Art Rare #217 SV8a PSA 9 (Terastal Festival, ~$150+ graded) and Gengar & Mimikyu GX Tag Bolt PSA 8 (~$30-50). Listed $1, likely placeholder. Check: real asking price, PSA cert numbers verify on psacard.com, slab not tampered, both cards included.
Three brass hunting/coach horns, plain unmarked, decorative value ~$30-70 for all three; $36 is at market.
